# Locally hosted GSAP assets

The portfolio uses the production distributions from **GSAP 3.15.0** and **ScrollTrigger 3.15.0** so the animation layer does not make a third-party CDN request.

- Upstream repository: https://github.com/greensock/GSAP
- GSAP distribution: https://github.com/greensock/GSAP/tree/3.15.0/dist
- Official Standard "No Charge" GSAP License: https://gsap.com/community/standard-license/

The original copyright/license notices are retained in the bundled files. When updating, replace both files with the same pinned GSAP release and run `npm run check:all`.
